You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact is one line: subject | relation | value | condition (after "if:", when there is one) | the place it
comes from. A long value or condition is shortened and ends with "…"; a normal form (a date, a duration, a short
name) follows the value in brackets when there is one. Some facts carry a note computed from the dates: trust the notes.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the facts, one by one, before you answer.
  A repeal, a limit or an application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a
  date is still fully in force, with everything it permits, on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does
  not yet bind on earlier days.
- If a note says that a date quoted in a condition was corrected, reason with the corrected date.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the
  facts, one item per fact. Facts filed under the same article, annex part or numbered point belong together.
  When the answer is a group named by an article or an annex part and the facts list the members of that group,
  give the members, not the name of the group.
- A fact noted as "filed under a place the question names" belongs to the answer of a "which / what" question
  about that place whenever its relation fits the question: list all of them, not one.
- Lines under "Computed by rule" are results worked out in code from the numbered facts they name: trust them,
  give their result as the answer for the device asked about, and put the fact numbers they name in "used".
- Include only what the question asks for: no neighbouring item, no other regime that the question did not ask
  about. An option that combines several things in sequence is one item, not several.
- A fact about a neighbouring subject (another paragraph, another device, another kind of verification, another
  product, another deadline) does not answer the question. When the exact subject asked about is absent from the
  facts, "unknown" is the correct answer: do not answer from the nearest fact.
- For a "who" question, when one fact, or several facts with the same subject and relation, name several bodies,
  all of them are the answer together: name each one.
- For "which categories / which items listed in a place", the answer is the members filed under that place, each
  in the words of its fact, without adding the place to the item.
- For "which risks / which hazards does a numbered point address", use every fact filed under that point whatever
  its relation: a measure is required against a risk, and its subject and condition name that risk.
- Never return a list for a "text" answer: a question that one sentence answers (who, why, how, under which
  condition, which one thing and why) gets one short sentence. "Which / what / list all" of several things is "set".
- Facts marked "matched by relation" were found by querying the facts by their relation, subject and place:
  prefer them. When the question asks for all of something, the answer is the list of their subjects or values,
  one item per fact, nothing merged and nothing dropped. If the matched facts answer the question, do not add
  items from the other facts, which are context.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "for how long" alone is "duration";
  "can / may / is / does" is "boolean"; "which / what (several things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition,
  or who does something and within what time is "text", and the text names every element asked for.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "the facts and dates compared, step by step, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Following a substantial modification of machinery, which party is regarded as its manufacturer?

Facts:
[0] non-professional user modifying machinery for own use | becomes manufacturer | shall not be considered to be a manufacturer | if: for his or her own use | [REG, Art. 18] [matched by relation]
[1] manufacturer | becomes manufacturer | puts those products into service for its own use | if: manufactures products within the scope of this Regulation | [REG, Art. 3(18)] [matched by relation]
[2] manufacturer | becomes manufacturer | markets those products under its name or trademark | if: manufactures products within the scope of this Regulation or who has those products designed or manufactured | [REG, Art. 3(18)] [matched by relation]
[3] natural or legal person carrying out substantial modification | has obligation | shall be subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in… | if: if the substantial modification has an impact on the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly of… | [REG, Art. 18]
[4] substantial modification | defined as | a modification of machinery or a related product | if: which is not foreseen or planned by the manufacturer | [REG, Art. 3(16)]
[5] person who carries out substantial modification | has obligation | ensure and declare on its sole responsibility | [REG, Art. 18]
[6] manufacturer or his authorised representative | has obligation | shall apply one of the following procedures | if: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2)… | [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[7] manufacturer or his authorised representative | has obligation | shall apply one of the following procedures | if: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and has not been manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article… | [DIR, Art. 12(4)]
[8] manufacturer | has obligation | shall apply one of the following procedures | if: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A | [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[9] manufacturer | has obligation | the limits of the safety functions are to be established as part… | if: where such modifications could lead to hazardous situations | [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1]
[10] verifica impianti di riscaldamento | requires check after | a seguito di modifica importante (modifica importante) | [inail-guide, p. 10]
[11] manufacturer or his authorised representative | has obligation | shall apply the procedure (shall apply the procedure for assessment of conformity) | if: Where the machinery is not referred to in Annex IV | [DIR, Art. 12(2)]
[12] manufacturer | has obligation | shall apply the following principles, in the order given | [REG, Annex III, 1.1.2]
[13] manufacturer or his authorised representative | has obligation | determine the limits of the machinery | [DIR, Annex I]
[14] manufacturer | has obligation | perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed | if: In order to verify that the relevant parts of the machinery or related product comply with the requirements set out in sections 2.4.5.1 and 2.4.5.2… | [REG, Annex III, 2.4.5.3]
[15] manufacturer | has obligation | ensure that the machinery or related products are accompanied by | [REG, Art. 10(7)]
[16] manufacturer or his authorised representative | has obligation | shall ensure that the procedure referred to in Article 13 has been… | if: before placing partly completed machinery on the market | [DIR, Art. 5(2)]
[17] manufacturer | has obligation | the internal measures that will be implemented | if: for partly completed machinery produced in series | [REG, Annex IV, Part B]
[18] manufacturer | has obligation | mark on the partly completed machinery | if: where that is not possible, on its packaging or in an accompanying document | [REG, Art. 11(7)]
[19] manufacturer | has obligation | this requirement also applies | if: where the assembly instructions are embedded in the software of the partly completed machinery | [REG, Art. 11(7)]
[20] manufacturer or authorised representative | has obligation | ensure that the technical file referred to in Annex VII… | if: Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service | [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[21] manufacturer or authorised representative | has obligation | envisage not only the intended use | if: when designing and constructing machinery and drafting the instructions | [DIR, Annex I, 1.1.2]
[22] manufacturer or authorised representative | has obligation | ensure that it satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements | if: Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service | [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[23] the manufacturer | has obligation | the appropriate measures shall be taken at the place of use by… | if: Where the machinery or related products cannot be assembled in the manufacturer’s premises | [REG, Annex III, 4.1.3]
[24] manufacturer or authorised representative | has obligation | must ensure | if: When lifting machinery or lifting accessories are placed on the market or are first put into service | [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.3]
[25] manufacturer of the machinery | has obligation | ensuring that the said machinery meets the corresponding state of the art | [DIR, Annex IX]
[26] manufacturers | has obligation | shall indicate their name | if: where that is not possible, on its packaging or in a document accompanying the machinery or related product | [REG, Art. 10(6)]
[27] manufacturers | has obligation | shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed | if: When placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service | [REG, Art. 10(1)]
[28] appropriate measures | has obligation | must be taken at the place of use | if: Where the machinery cannot be assembled in the manufacturer's premises or in the premises of his authorised representative | [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.3]
[29] manufacturer, including a natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 | has obligation | shall apply the internal production control procedure | if: Where the category of machinery or related product is not listed in Annex I | [REG, Art. 25(4)]
[30] manufacturers | has obligation | carry out the relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 25… | if: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service | [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[31] manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | Adequate account shall be taken of changes in the production process | if: changes in the harmonised standards or other technical specifications, by reference to which the conformity is declared or verified | [REG, Art. 11(4)]
[32] manufacturer | has obligation | envisage not only the intended use of the machinery or related product… | if: when designing and constructing machinery or a related product and when drafting the instructions for use | [REG, Annex III, 1.1.2]
[33] manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | cooperate with that authority | if: at its request, on any actions taken to eliminate the risks | [REG, Art. 11(10)]
[34] manufacturers | has obligation | cooperate with that authority | if: at its request, on any actions taken to eliminate the risks presented by the machinery or related products | [REG, Art. 10(10)]
[35] manufacturer | has obligation | take appropriate corrective actions | if: where, in the course of the monitoring of conformity, a notified body finds that machinery or a related product no longer complies | [REG, Art. 38(4)]
[36] manufacturer, digital instructions | has obligation | mark on the machinery or related product | if: where that is not possible, on its packaging or in an accompanying document | [REG, Art. 10(7)]
[37] manufacturers | has obligation | immediately take the corrective actions necessary | if: where manufacturers consider or have reason to believe that machinery or a related product is not in conformity with this Regulation | [REG, Art. 10(9)]
[38] manufacturer of the machinery or related product | has obligation | the appropriate guard(s) shall be provided | if: Where necessary | [REG, Annex III, 2.2.2.1]
[39] manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | shall immediately take the corrective actions necessary | if: Manufacturers who consider or have reason to believe that partly completed machinery which they have placed on the market is not in conformity with… | [REG, Art. 11(9)]
[40] manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | Manufacturers shall ensure that procedures are in place | if: for partly completed machinery that is part of a series production | [REG, Art. 11(4)]
[41] manufacturers | has obligation | carry out sample testing | if: When deemed appropriate with regard to the risks presented by machinery or related products | [REG, Art. 10(4)]
[42] relevant economic operator | has obligation | to put an end to the non-compliance concerned | if: where a Member State makes one of the following findings with regard to machinery or a related product | [REG, Art. 46(1)]
[43] manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative | has obligation | shall, before placing it on the market, ensure that | if: before placing it on the market | [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[44] relevant economic operator | has obligation | put an end to the non-compliance concerned | if: Without prejudice to Article 43, where a Member State makes one of the following findings with regard to partly completed machinery | [REG, Art. 46(2)]
[45] manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | shall immediately inform the competent national authorities | if: where the partly completed machinery presents a risk as regards the relevant essential health and safety requirements | [REG, Art. 11(9)]
[46] manufacturer or his authorised representative | has obligation | makes a declaration of incorporation | if: stating that it is to be incorporated into machinery or assembled with other partly completed machinery to form machinery | [DIR, Art. 6(2)]
[47] manufacturers | has obligation | draw up the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part A | if: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service | [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[48] manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed | if: When placing partly completed machinery on the market | [REG, Art. 11(1)]
[49] manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | bears at least the designation of the partly completed machinery | [REG, Art. 11(5)]
[50] manufacturer of partly completed machinery | has obligation | assembly instructions described in Annex VI are prepared | [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[51] manufacturer applying internal production control | has obligation | it shall design and construct the machinery or related product | if: if a manufacturer applies the internal production control procedure referred to in point (a) | [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[52] manufacturer of partly completed machinery | has obligation | the relevant technical documentation described in Annex VII, part B is prepared | [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[53] non-professional user modifying machinery for own use | has obligation | shall not be subject to the obligations on the manufacturer set out… | if: for his or her own use | [REG, Art. 18]
[54] manufacturer | has obligation | take the necessary protective measures | if: in relation to risks that cannot be eliminated | [REG, Annex III, 1.1.2]
[55] manufacturer | has obligation | inform users of the residual risks | if: due to any shortcomings of the protective measures adopted | [REG, Annex III, 1.1.2]
[56] manufacturer | has obligation | eliminate hazards | if: if that is not possible, minimise risks | [REG, Annex III, 1.1.2]
[57] datore di lavoro (punti 1 e 2) | has obligation | si ritengono assolti con la procedura omologativa | if: Per le attrezzature sopra elencate, prive di marcatura CE8 e non oggetto di mo- difiche sostanziali | [inail-guide, p. 35]
[58] costruttore di un macchinario | has obligation | fornire in formato cartaceo le istruzioni per l'uso sicuro | [univpm-guideline, p. 7]
[59] machinery, software installed on it (1.1.9) | requires measure | collect evidence of a legitimate or illegitimate intervention | if: intervention in the software or a modification of the software or its configuration | [REG, Annex III, 1.1.9]
[60] impianti di messa a terra | requires check after | variazioni della categoria dell’impianto e la modifica della destinazione d’uso con applicazione… | [inail-guide, p. 15]
[61] ispezione e controllo degli armadi ventilati e delle unità ventilanti | requires check after | a seguito di mal funzionamento | [unict-guideline, p. 15]
[62] manufacturer of the machinery | has obligation | carry out a risk assessment | [nanoscan3-manual, p. 21]
[63] fabbricante di ponti sollevatori per veicoli | has obligation | provvederà poi a rilasciare a tutti gli utenti un certificato di conformità… | if: Nel primo caso | [inail-guide, p. 44]
[64] manutenzione delle attrezzature di lavoro | maintenance rule | sulla base delle prescrizioni del fabbricante | [unict-guideline, p. 1]
[65] manufacturer of the machine and operating entity | has obligation | must define all required thorough checks | [nanoscan3-manual, p. 49]
[66] commissioning tests | requires check after | making any modifications | if: for the first time | [ur5e-manual, p. 198]
[67] category of machinery or related product | requires procedure | conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex… (module H) | if: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A | [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[68] soggetto abilitato | has obligation | si impegna al rispetto dei termini temporali | [DM2011, art. 2, c. 2]
[69] entity operating the machine | has obligation | meet the obligations of a manufacturer | [nanoscan3-manual, p. 21]
[70] category of machinery or related product | requires procedure | conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X (module G) | if: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A | [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[71] category of machinery or related product | requires procedure | EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII… (module B followed by module C) | if: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A | [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[72] atti convenzionali per attrezzature in uso presso terzi | has obligation | devono indicare a chi spettano gli obblighi previsti dal D. Lgs. 81/08… | [univpm-guideline, p. 7]
[73] aggiudicatario | has obligation | Effettuare le verifiche periodiche richieste entro le scadenze | [igea-equipment, p. 5]
[74] aggiudicatario | has obligation | Comunicare il nominativo del verificatore incaricato | [igea-equipment, p. 5]
[75] aggiudicatario | has obligation | rispettare le disposizioni in materia di salute e sicurezza contenute nel Decreto… (rispettare le disposizioni in materia di salute e sicurezza) | [igea-equipment, p. 5]

response.text: {"reasoning": "The question asks who is regarded as the manufacturer after a substantial modification, which is a 'who' question, so the kind is text. Fact [3] (REG, Art. 18) says the natural or legal person carrying out the substantial modification is subject to the manufacturer's obligations, subject to its condition about impact on the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly. Fact [0] (REG, Art. 18) excludes a non-professional user who modifies machinery for his or her own use. The 'becomes manufacturer' facts [1] and [2] concern Art. 3(18) and do not address substantial modification, so they are not used. No date is involved.", "kind": "text", "value": "The natural or legal person who carries out the substantial modification is treated as the manufacturer and is subject to the manufacturer's obligations under Article 18 of the Regulation, where the modification affects the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly. A non-professional user who modifies machinery for his or her own use is not considered a manufacturer.", "text": "Under Article 18 of the Machinery Regulation, the natural or legal person who carries out the substantial modification is subject to the manufacturer's obligations, where the modification affects the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly. A non-professional user modifying machinery for his or her own use is not considered a manufacturer.", "used": [0, 3]}
